title: Object Repository element links
description: A non-empty array with one entry per (activity, element) pair, each linking an existing Object Repository element to a target property of an activity in a XAML workflow.

workflowFilePath.description: Absolute path of the .xaml workflow inside the project directory, with forward slashes (a backslash is a JSON escape). A relative path resolves against the CLI working directory, not --project-dir.

activityId.description: The activity's sap2010:WorkflowViewState.IdRef in the workflow (for example 'NClick_3').

referenceId.description: Reference ID of the Object Repository element to link, as printed by create-elements or get-elements.

targetProperty.description: Activity property that receives the element. Dotted paths address nested properties (for example 'SearchedElement.Target', 'VerifyOptions.Target'). Omitted or empty means 'Target'.
